title: rosa coriifolia var. pubescens
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy rose, is a variety of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia var. pubescens include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
